messages:
sam_ops: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: capacity and autoscale. Posting a couple concrete asks so we can close action items.

ana_infra: thanks! first Q: what exactly changed for APAC zone ordering? the slide looked like late Q3 -> now unclear.

raf_capacity: we re-prioritized based on vendor lead times. Core APAC cities (SIN, TYO) still late Q3; secondary zones moved to early Q4. ETA update will be in the procurement board tomorrow.

neha_research: will that affect model rollouts that rely on lower-precision quantized variants? we saw slight eval drift in staging.

raf_capacity: plan is to enable in-region quantized variants first, gate with per-customer evals. If a zone isn't live we fall back to cross-region compatible variant, with p99 +200ms expected overhead.

sam_ops: second Q: autoscale burst behavior for Dedicated customers — do we ever spill to hosted?

ana_infra: Dedicated w/ isolation setting = no hosted spill. Autoscaler will queue and trigger alerts. For non-isolated tiers we allow hosted fallback per policy.

deploy-bot: Release infra/autoscaler-config@v2 deployed to eu-west-1, us-west-2 (sha=def456).

sam_ops: perfect. can we add a dashboard tile for queued-to-served latency? that caught us during the demo.

ana_infra: will add metric infra.queue.latency.p95 and a short runbook paragraph. expected in next deploy.

sam_ops: great, thanks all. closing once zone timeline and dashboard are posted.
